sources.entry: AI Video Enhancer - Enhance video quality using AI.

summary.name: Topaz Video
summary.one_liner: Topaz Video is AI video enhancement software that upscales, sharpens, denoises, stabilizes, and smooths footage, sold through tiered subscription plans.
use_cases: Creating slow motion with frame interpolation
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Topaz Video as AI software that upscales, enhances, stabilizes, and smooths footage using temporally aware AI models that can be compared against each other. Plan listings name video features such as Precision Upscale, Creative Upscale, Frame Interpolation, Slow Motion, SDR to HDR, and Stabilization. Other plan listings mention related Topaz tools for photos (Topaz Photo, Topaz Gigapixel), mobile, and web, and features such as denoise, sharpen, unblur, and face enhancement. Several model names are listed, including Starlight, Proteus, Iris, Rhea, and Wonder 3. The page includes testimonials and pricing tiers, but it does not describe a detailed workflow.
notable: Temporally aware AI models for video upscaling and enhancement
SDR to HDR conversion and stabilization
Cloud access to some models on web plans
caveats: Paid subscription tiers; the page cites a limited-time discount of up to 50% off
Monthly credits expire at month end and do not roll over
Commercial use free only for organizations under $1M USD annual revenue
Web export limits apply on web products
